arguments.analyst: Observed brightness spans 4.03 (I47V:I161V) to 1.30 (four-edit O4/O5), so the evidence supports conservative single-class edits and penalizes bulky multi-edit combinations. The I229X and T97X entries are the highest-scoring menu candidates, consistent with the I161V-conservative pattern in O1.
arguments.hypothesis: Conservative substitutions at buried/aliphatic positions (I161V, I229V, I229T, M153V, T97S) retain high log brightness, whereas adding multiple non-conservative polar/charged edits drops it sharply.
